name: Sarah Morris
headline: Director Professional Practice, at Royal Victoria Regional Health Centre
about: A strong background in clinical practice specifically relating to critical care in both Canada and the UK. Passionate about professional practice supported by evidence based practice, quality improvement and change management techniques while having patient and family centered care as the cornerstone of how this is achieved. Heavily involved in leading corporate projects relating to clinical practice and education. Patient safety and quality care is my priority.

experiences.position: Director Professional Practice, IPAC & Allied Health Services

experiences.description: Responsible for the professional practice in the cardiovascular program (inpatient and outpatient areas). Leading using change management techniques and quality improvement practices. Aligning all practices with best practice guidelines and patient and family centered care. Responsible for corporate wide educational initiatives and involved in corporate wide project planning and roll-out.

Program development for the nursing health assessment course specific to individual hospital required content. Assisted with program development for the International Nursing program. Responsible for preparing and teaching the Health Assessment course, evaluation of the practitioners undertaking the course providing feedback at the clinical practice labs.
Worked within the ICU as an RN caring for critically ill patients.

experiences.companyName: UHSM - University Hospital of South Manchester NHS FT
experiences.description: Managed students through partnering universities for the Registered Nursing programs along with Allied Professional programs. Involved in curriculum development, mentor development and facilitation.

experiences.companyName: UHSM - University Hospital of South Manchester NHS FT
experiences.description: Worked in the Cardiothoracic Intensive Care Unit as a RN. Caring for critically ill patients post cardiac or thoracic surgery including transplantation.
Worked as an RN on an Acute In-patient Medical Unit from 2000-2001. Then in 2001 I took the Critical Care course and began working in the ICU from 2001-2008
